title: Agree to wait

title: Response to new total
prompt: What did the customer say after the cashier told them the new total was 100?
hint: Report the customer's words in one sentence: they said it was manageable and they were relieved.
sample: They said it was manageable and they were relieved.

ja.hint: お客さんの言葉を一文で答えましょう：『それなら大丈夫で安心しました』の意味です。
ja.sample: それなら大丈夫で、安心しました。
